title: RAW_UNSCREENED: one water referent changes state from source to renewal
summary: XI Sancta Anastasia gives a complete fresh-at-source, removed, cooled, and renewed-water sequence with distinct outcomes; a source-state chain predicts repeated water references carry state and a terminal renewal condition.

design.mechanism: Repeated water references in one complete entry are one referent whose state changes fresh at source -> removed -> cooled -> renewed.
source_clauses_exact: Illa recens in fonte suo sinthomata tollit,
Fonte relicta suo nichil affert utilitatis;
Hec eadem prodest frigida facta parum.
design.whole_reading: A complete paragraph would preserve a source-state/outcome chain and make renewed water a condition of renewed aid.
design.nearest_rival: Repeated bath-water praise with independent local mentions and no state carry.
design.distinguishing_observation: Require ordered fresh -> removed -> cooled -> renewed dependencies and a terminal renewal condition in a complete source-frozen reading.
design.strongest_likely_failure: Water mentions do not share a referent, or state order and renewal dependency cannot be maintained without local repairs.
assumption_costs: The four clauses share one water referent.
design.scope_note: Source-only raw proposal; no target text, target fit, or medical truth claim.
